name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-powered presentation builder that produces polished decks without generic, over-designed output.
problem: Most AI presentation tools generate visually cluttered, template-heavy slides that feel impersonal and require heavy manual cleanup. Chronicle 2.0 addresses the gap between speed and quality, letting teams produce on-brand, design-conscious presentations without sacrificing control. It targets professionals who need AI efficiency but refuse to compromise on aesthetic credibility.
useCases: Creating investor pitch decks with clean, professional design
Producing internal strategy or roadmap decks without a designer
Repurposing written content into structured slide narratives
